description: Executable Candidate Ray TP2 recipe for Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 Omni (text, image, video and audio input) as lukealonso's NVFP4 checkpoint on two Sparks, following MiaAI-Lab's MiMo-V2.5-vLLM-Dual-DGX-Sparks kit: its published dev vLLM 0.21.1rc1 image pinned by digest, the kit's mods and engine patches replayed at build time, NVFP4 KV cache through the DiffKV Triton backend, MTP with one token, FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE, mimo tool-call and reasoning parsers, eager mode, 1M context and three sequences (Vonk runs two). Code: no licence file upstream (the image labels itself Apache-2.0); model: MIT (base XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.5; the quantization repository has no licence file). The model card says it needs its own SGLang image on RTX PRO 6000; the kit runs it on GB10. The kit builds on tonyd2wild's MiMo-V2.5 NVFP4-KV work. Upstream reports about 30 tok/s single stream and about 56 tok/s cumulative at three streams on its pair (claims until measured here), and a 2.7M-token KV pool at 0.83 memory utilization, so only about two full-1M requests fit at once. Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Thinking default is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Thinking off unless a request enables it (upstream default). Absolute KV correction: 6,633,354,240 bytes per rank and a 0.752936 startup budget; the pool covers 2 simultaneous full-context requests at 1,000,000 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound, and leaves room for the about 21 GB per rank this build used beside its weights and KV on hardware plus the 6 GB platform floor. The creator context is retained. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: MiMo V2.5 Omni NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks (Mia)
